answer: At dawn each epoch, a random committee audits a prism of identity signals (proof-of-personhood attestations, hardware roots, past work history) and slashes the bond of any duplicate cluster. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge whose difficulty scales with a moving delta tracking total registrations. Creating N sybils costs N bonds plus N audit exposures, so the marginal attacker cost grows linearly while honest agents pay once. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
